prompts.strikes: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 3 by 3 attack-pose sprite atlas for the existing original game Spark: The Substrate. Input image is a character identity and rendering-style reference only. Create nine NEW dynamic side-view punch/forelimb attack poses, all facing RIGHT, one fully visible character in each equal square cell, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows, transparent background throughout. Row1: gold flame held out in a hooded hand (Spark), hooded armored Human thrusting a clenched glowing hand, gold-veined wolf Animal lunging with its foreclaws. Row2: root-lit Tree swinging a long branch fist, cracked basalt Rock driving a stone fist, cyan polyhedron Computer projecting an angular cyan strike. Row3: teal shadow Collector reaching with hooked grasping hands, gold crystal Archon firing a prism from one arm, ivory and gold bell-armored Cantor raising its ring-lit arm. Preserve each reference identity, materials, existing palette and readable silhouette. Painterly high-detail fantasy game illustration, metallic edge highlights and jewel-like glowing cores, clean isolated alpha edges, coherent rim lighting. Ground line at 88% of every cell; every foot/paw/base rests on it, body centered at 47% of cell; keep attacks inside cell with 8% margin and no neighboring spill. No text, no borders, no scenery, no blood, no recognizable commercial fighting-game costumes, no new characters. Square atlas.

No text, no frames, no scenery, no blood, no copied commercial fighter designs, no additional characters. Square atlas.
prompts.stages: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: six horizontal arena backgrounds in an exact 2-column by 3-row atlas for Spark: The Substrate, an original substrate fighter. Entire image landscape width twice height; each of the six rectangular cells must itself be 16:9, equal size with no gutters or borders. Row1 left Threshold Glass: cavernous ruined teal glass arches, fractured mirrored columns and gold floor glyphs; right Tideglass: submerged teal observatory with distant water light, broken prism windows. Row2 left Root: ancient living root archive, huge root arches and faint green-gold illuminated leaves; right Basalt: dark fault-carved basalt hall, fissures softly glowing amber. Row3 left Night: deep indigo mirror nursery, pale reflected luminous rings and glass lattice; right Orbit: quiet cyan array of suspended geometric substrate rings and circuitry. Same painterly high-detail game art, textured stone/metals, volumetric rays, dramatic gold and teal lighting, haunting and beautiful, no new gods or lore. Fixed side-on camera. Every cell needs a flat straight floor line at 81% height, dark clear open fighting lane from 20%-80% horizontal and 45%-81% vertical, architecture behind lane, strongest ornamental focus in background not foreground. Foreground floor extends to bottom. No fighters, no text, no UI, no image borders, no recognizable borrowed stages.
